description: This file defines the ImpactItemProjectCostForm class, which manages a form for selecting and saving project costs related to impact items within a project, utilizing Symfony form components and project-specific models.

classes.name: ImpactItemProjectCostForm
classes.description: A form handler class for selecting and saving project costs associated with impact items.

methods.name: getProjectCosts
methods.description: Retrieves all costs associated with the project linked to the impact item, returning an array of costs keyed by cost description.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds the form with a choice field populated with project costs and a submit button.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates the form, retrieves selected cost data, updates the model, and saves it. Throws exceptions on errors.
